Conquest
%message%
Blue against Red over the capture points of %map%, %size% a side. Each level bracket plays its own match. Free places are filled with fake players of your level, who fight in parties led by their team's commander.
Every capture point the other team holds more than yours drains your score; a team at 0 loses, and after %fight% minutes the higher score wins: %reward% each. Every kill gives a Sealed Cache.%top%
A party plays in one team, its leader leading it. A party of fewer than 5 gets fake players in the roles it lacks; alone, you lead 4 of them. A party with members of different brackets is broken up, each member plays in their own bracket.
Brackets: %brackets%
Registration closes in %time%. Registered: %count% (%bracket_count% in your bracket).
You: %you%
